text_block_list.text:
Crowd gathered in front of central 
plaza... Curious, went over to check 
situation.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
*cough* Uh... p-pony-chan? Tell me your... 
n-no, your troubles... L-Lay 'em on me!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: B-Big sis...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
C-C-Clouding such lovely eyes... Uhh, 
spare me that, or somethin'...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ama-san, what are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Brian! Looking good... Great hair 
today! Makes me wanna... uh, challenge you 
to duel right now!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Haah, come here.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Why copying Fuji? Said you hated acting 
all slick.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Well, y'know... Got reasons for this...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That girl lives in my dorm. Been brooding 
over something forever.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Seems she talks to Fuji, but as dorm 
leader, should've been me listening to 
her, right? Yet...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Am I that unreliable? Dorm leader who 
can't handle one problem... damn it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Ama-san.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Right! How was I just now!? Acting like 
Fuji, seemed bit more dependable—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Look pathetic. Copying someone isn't like 
you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Wha...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Where's fire you show in races? No one 
could confide in you like this.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Forget yourself, and nobody will rely on 
you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Harsh... but true. Lost sight of myself. 
Picking tricks before even challenging 
head-on.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Eyes open now, thanks. Gonna face her 
fair and square!

Later, Hishi Amazon solved dormmate's 
problem. Dormmates rely on her even more 
now, and she looks delighted.
